13:06.race_name: It Pays To Buy Irish Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Ran well until fading over Cheltenham's stiff, extended 2m4f; solid claims back down to 2m
runners.name: Secret Des Dieux
runners.spotlight: Won on chase debut at Fakenham (2m, good to soft) in October and has run well in defeat on his three starts since, most recently at Cheltenham when not seeing out the stiff, extended 2m4f on soft ground; solid claims now back down in trip.

runners.comment: Won at Taunton in January; below par since but drops back in grade today; could go well
runners.name: Hypotenus
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the 11th attempt over fences at Taunton (2m, good) in January, and he's run well on testing ground in the past; below par on his last two starts but drops back in grade today and could give a good account.

runners.comment: The drop back in trip could help on her second chase start and she's not written off
runners.name: Epinephrine
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 6yo who was effective on testing ground in France and won over hurdles at Kempton (2m, good to soft) in February; she's struggled on both starts this season, most recently her chase debut, but the drop back in trip could help and she's not written off.

13:41.race_name: ITM At Huntingdon Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Below par on the Flat prior to being well beaten at 300-1 on first two hurdle starts
runners.name: Different Drum
runners.spotlight: Went close on the Flat last July (2m1f, soft) but below par in that code subsequently and well beaten at 300-1 on first two hurdle starts.

runners.comment: 0-7 over hurdles but frequently placed and has leading claims in this weak race
runners.name: Idaho Valley
runners.spotlight: Point winner who is 0-7 over hurdles and hasn't progressed, but he's finished in the first three on five of his seven starts in this sphere (including on soft ground) and holds leading claims in this weak race.

runners.comment: Down the field in all four bumpers and tailed off at 150-1 on last month's hurdle debut
runners.name: Kampari
runners.spotlight: Down the field in all four bumpers and tailed off at 150-1 on last month's hurdle debut at Fakenham.

runners.comment: Fifth at Ludlow on second British start and could build on that run; possible player
runners.name: Lejo Du Seuil
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in October on final French start (2m2f, very soft); no threat on either outing in Britain but ran better when 17l fifth at Ludlow (2m, soft) a fortnight ago and could build on that run today; possible player.

runners.comment: Tailed off at Lingfield a fortnight ago but he's better than that; could have part to play
runners.name: Lord Virginia
runners.spotlight: Tailed off at Lingfield (2m, heavy) a fortnight ago but he's better than that, as evidenced by his 15l third at Hereford (2m, soft) last month; could have a part to play if bouncing back this afternoon.

runners.breeder: M Jean-Charles Haimet & M Olivier Tricot
runners.comment: Big odds and well beaten in this hood on his first two starts; improvement is necessary
runners.name: Out Of It
runners.owner: Mrs C S Wilson And Miss C Lees-Jones
runners.spotlight: Big odds and well beaten in this hood on his first two starts (2m/1m7f, good to soft/soft); improvement is necessary.

runners.comment: There's potential in his pedigree but he's shown little on his first two starts
runners.name: Scrumpyjack
runners.spotlight: There's potential in his pedigree and it's very early days, but he was well beaten in his sole bumper and pulled up at 150-1 on hurdle debut at Doncaster (2m3f, soft) last month, after an absence; transformation needed.

runners.comment: In good hands and market check advised, but well beaten on all three starts
runners.name: Loro White
runners.spotlight: She's with a respected trainer and is one to watch in the betting in a first-time tongue-tie but she's been well beaten on all three starts.

runners.comment: She's raced five times and hasn't shown enough to suggest she'll be making an impact today
runners.name: Mcflo
runners.spotlight: She's raced five times (three of them over hurdles) and hasn't shown enough to suggest she'll be making an impact today.

runners.comment: Wore this hood in both bumpers and finished down the field at triple-figure odds each time
runners.name: Simply A Dancer
runners.spotlight: Wore this hood in both bumpers and finished down the field at triple-figure odds each time (2m, good to soft/soft); others are preferred.

runners.breeder: R P Philips & Chapel Stud Ltd
runners.comment: Well beaten on sole hurdle start but has shown ability on the Flat; not ruled out each-way
runners.name: Burano Murano
runners.spotlight: Well beaten at 50-1 in November on sole hurdle start but he's shown ability on the Flat, including on heavy ground, and is not ruled out each-way in this weak contest.

runners.comment: 11-race maiden on the Flat but he's shown some ability; might have an each-way shout
runners.name: Paragon
runners.spotlight: 11-race maiden on the Flat but he's shown some ability and goes hurdling in a race very much lacking depth; might have an each-way shout.

14:16.race_name: Think Thoroughbred, Think Ireland Handicap Chase

runners.comment: Makes chase debut after absence; trainer has better strike-rate with chasers than hurdlers
runners.name: Dublin To Milan
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent over hurdles and well beaten last April when last seen but was a 7l second at Stratford (2m6f, good) prior to that; showed promise in points in spring 2023 (including on soft ground) and trainer has better strike-rate with chasers compared to hurdlers; interesting on chase debut.

runners.breeder: P De Maleissye Melun & T Amos
runners.comment: Easily made all in first-time visor over C&D (soft) a fortnight ago; strong claims up 10lb
runners.name: Carpe Diem
runners.spotlight: Very mixed record under rules but he won a point last May and easily made all in a first-time visor over C&D (soft) a fortnight ago; strong claims up 10lb if the headgear maintains its positive effect.

runners.breeder: S A R L Ecurie Lafeu
runners.comment: Well beaten on last two starts but ran well in November and gets a change of headgear
runners.name: Ballywood
runners.spotlight: 12yo; well beaten on last two starts but before those he ran well when third at Ffos Las (2m3f, soft) where 8lb higher; of interest on that form and perhaps the first-time blinkers (replacing a visor) will give him a boost.

runners.comment: Won over hurdles last January but well beaten this season on first three chase starts
runners.name: Owl Of Athens
runners.spotlight: Won by 8l over hurdles at Uttoxeter (2m4f, good to soft) last January and on that evidence this 4lb higher mark shouldn't be beyond him; however, he's been well beaten this season on his first three chase starts.

runners.comment: 0-17 under rules and well beaten in fifth in points on his last two starts
runners.name: Ceejaybe
runners.spotlight: Close third over fences at Fontwell last April but such high points have been scarce in his winless, 17-race rules career; well-beaten fifth in points on his last two starts; reverts to rules with something to prove.

runners.comment: Chasing newcomer; has shown little over hurdles but dam was a two-time chase winner
runners.name: Cracker Muddle
runners.spotlight: Tailed off at big odds on all three hurdle starts and she's 3lb wrong at the weights for this handicap/chase debut; however, her dam was a two-time chase winner and this very lightly raced 8yo might improve for fences; interesting to see how she goes in the betting.

14:51.race_name: Visit Irish Bloodstock Sales With ITM EBF Mares' "National Hunt" Maiden Hurdle (EBF Qaul') (GBB)

runners.comment: Modest last run but repeat of Southwell fourth would see her beat the majority of these
runners.name: Blue Marvel
runners.spotlight: Disappointing run at Fontwell last time (2m1f, soft) but she had shaped quite well the time before at Southwell (2m4f, good to soft), a repeat of which would see her beat the majority of these.

runners.comment: 100-1 when refusing to race at Wetherby and 200-1 when tailed off at Fakenham
runners.name: Callmesusie
runners.spotlight: Only 1-14 in points; 100-1 when refusing to race at Wetherby and 200-1 when she trailed home tailed off at Fakenham.

runners.comment: Exposed as a very moderate and has a basement handicap mark
runners.name: Dont Cheddar Tear
runners.spotlight: Exposed as a very moderate and has a basement handicap mark.

runners.comment: Completely tailed off in two bumpers for her previous yard; has had a wind operation
runners.name: Indigo Sky
runners.spotlight: Completely tailed off in two bumpers for her previous yard; now with Lucy Wadham and has had a wind operation; all hope is not yet lost.

runners.comment: Placed in French bumper; struggled badly in three runs for W Mullins; still with top owner
runners.name: Kom Tu Voudras
runners.spotlight: Placed in a French bumper; struggled badly in three runs for Willie Mullins (the first was a Grade 1) as her third at Tramore was very remote; hood tried last time is now removed; positives can be taken that she remains in top ownership and Harry Cobden takes over.

runners.comment: Runner-up in a Chepstow bumper two years ago and returns in a modest maiden hurdle
runners.name: Midnight Venture
runners.spotlight: Very mixed messages as to what she achieved in a Chepstow bumper two years ago as the winner has turned out to be very limited but the third is useful; returns in a modest maiden hurdle, so has to be feared.

runners.comment: No great substance to her bumper form and she was beaten a long way at Doncaster
runners.name: Polkaface
runners.spotlight: No great substance to her bumper form and she was beaten a long way at Doncaster on her switch to hurdling (2m, good; 20-1); now has her tongue tied; much to prove.

runners.comment: Half-sister to 2m4f-3m1f chase winner A Definite Getaway; belated debut aged seven
runners.name: Run Suzie Run
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to 2m4f-3m1f chase winner A Definite Getaway; dam unraced half-sister to two winning jumpers; this is a belated debut at the age of seven.

runners.comment: Irish point winner; well held in two hurdle runs, albeit behind useful winners
runners.name: Spring Serenade
runners.spotlight: Won an Irish point by 10l on soft to heavy; beaten 45l and 29l in her two runs over hurdles but those races were at least won by good horses; could have some part to play in this softer contest.

runners.comment: Weak in the market for both her races under rules and hasn't shown much at all
runners.name: Warrioress
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in an Irish point; weak in the market for both her races under rules and hasn't shown much at all.

15:26.race_name: Irish Thoroughbred Marketing At Huntingdon Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: It's been a quiet start over hurdles but a hood goes on for handicap debut
runners.name: For Old Times Sake
runners.spotlight: Placed in Irish points; it's been a quiet start over hurdles but a hood goes on for handicap debut; market support would be welcomed.

runners.comment: 11-1 for handicap debut but was soon in trouble and tailed off; now no tongue-tie
runners.name: Glenmuick
runners.spotlight: At 11-1 he wasn't friendless in the betting for handicap debut at Market Rasen (2m4f, good to soft) but he was soon in trouble and tailed off; the first-time tongue-tie is swiftly removed here.

runners.comment: May be seen to better effect on this handicap debut should the market offer encouragement
runners.name: Peace In The Park
runners.spotlight: Placed in point/bumper but beaten 27l or more in three runs over hurdles, all at 2m on ground ranging from good to heavy; may be seen to better effect on this handicap debut should the market offer encouragement.

runners.comment: Arrives here in a solid run of form and has the least to prove of these
runners.name: Postponed Legacy
runners.spotlight: Went up 10lb for winning at Uttoxeter (2m, good to soft; completing a double) but was still competitive at Wincanton (soft) where he had a subsequent winner just behind him; nudged up another 1lb but has the least to prove of these.

runners.comment: The fifth at Uttoxeter three runs back was encouraging; not a lot since, though
runners.name: Neeps And Tatties
runners.owner: Dalziel Family K Rogers D Vowles
runners.spotlight: It was three runs back but his fifth at Uttoxeter (soft) was encouraging and her best run so far; could have a future in handicaps of this nature.

runners.comment: Lesser show upped to 2m5f at Kempton and it's perhaps unwise to blame the trip
runners.name: This Sway
runners.spotlight: Beaten only 12l on handicap debut at Windsor (2m, good) before a far lesser show upped to 2m5f at Kempton and it's perhaps unwise to blame the trip for that demise; not a solid option, especially with likely ground issues as well.

runners.comment: Not remotely threatening in her qualifying runs and ground this testing will be a first
runners.name: Glancing Back
runners.owner: Emma Bishop Racing Club & Mrs Mj Arnold
runners.spotlight: Not remotely threatening in her three qualifying runs and ground this testing will be a first; much to prove on handicap debut; has been hooded from the outset.

runners.comment: Hasn't raised his modest profile in two handicaps, over 2m4f on slow ground
runners.name: Steel Soldier
runners.spotlight: Hasn't raised his modest profile in two handicaps, over 2m4f on slow ground; hard to make a case.

runners.comment: Pulled up again on stable debut here two weeks ago after wind surgery
runners.name: Celine Man
runners.spotlight: His standout effort was in 2023; pulled up again on stable debut here two weeks ago after wind surgery.

runners.comment: Better for blinkers going on and was under 10l off the winner at Market Rasen last time
runners.name: Ramaah
runners.spotlight: AW winner; things have perked up a little since the blinkers went on and he was under 10l off the winner at Market Rasen last time (2m handicap on soft); could have some part to play.

runners.comment: No worthwhile form on the Flat or hurdling; 6lb wrong on handicap debut
runners.name: Cosmic Spirit
runners.spotlight: No worthwhile form on the Flat or hurdling; makes handicap debut from 6lb out of the weights and Joseph Stevenson has claimed 7lb in his three previous races.

16:01.race_name: Experience Irish Racing With ITM Mares' Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Cheekpieces added for this handicap debut and she may show more
runners.name: Connies Hill
runners.spotlight: Irish point winner; unconvincing form over hurdles, the best run when beaten 20l at Lingfield (2m, soft) on penultimate start; cheekpieces added for this handicap debut and she may show more.

runners.comment: 100-1 on handicap debut at Southwell but was best of the rest behind an odds-on winner
runners.name: Kellebelle
runners.spotlight: Had looked very limited and went off 100-1 for handicap debut at Southwell (2m4f, good to soft) but in a first-time tongue-tie she was best of the rest behind an odds-on winner; that improvement brings her into the reckoning.

runners.comment: Now 0-14 over hurdles but has run many a good race in handicaps, including last time
runners.name: After Many Days
runners.spotlight: 0-14 over hurdles but has run many a good race in handicaps, including last time at Leicester (2m4f, heavy) where she looked set to collect before reeled in late on; up 2lb but goes on heavy and should be bang there.

runners.comment: Tailed off in all three handicaps, last time finishing well behind Kellebelle
runners.name: Getarose
runners.spotlight: Tailed off in all three handicaps, last time finishing well behind Kellebelle when 80-1.

runners.comment: Not seen to best effect on yard debut and Sean Bowen takes over; better can be expected
runners.name: Natus Vincere
runners.spotlight: Irish point winner; picked up for £15,000 in October after heavy defeats in non-handicaps for previous yard; favourite for stable debut at Leicester (2m4f, heavy; first-time tongue-tie) after an absence but never got involved for a jockey having her first ride under rules; plenty to find with After Many Days on that run but Sean Bowen now takes over.

runners.comment: Has been running well from the front but not on heavy ground
runners.name: Prairie Queen
runners.spotlight: Has been running well from the front in handicaps at about 2m to 2m4f (on good and quicker); the negatives are a three-month absence and doubts about her handling heavy ground.

runners.breeder: S C E A Des Terrains DAvilly Saint Leon
runners.comment: Longstanding maiden who hasn't been showing much for a while now
runners.name: Liloo dOres
runners.spotlight: Longstanding maiden who hasn't been showing much for a while now; plenty to find with Kellebelle on latest run; visor now tried.

runners.comment: Better effort when fifth at Southwell yesterday but she didn't threaten and is now 0-11
runners.name: Sweet Serene
runners.spotlight: Having had a wind op she produced a better effort when fifth of 11 at 150-1 at Southwell (2m4f, soft) yesterday, and she's not so far out of the weights today; however, she didn't threaten and is now 0-11; others preferred.

16:36.race_name: Travel Incentive For British Buyers Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: This season's struggles continued when pulled up in the Surrey National
runners.name: Sporting Ace
runners.spotlight: Won last year's Surrey National (3m5f, heavy) off 3lb higher but this season's struggles continued when pulled up in the same race a month ago; has questions to answer.

runners.comment: Off since his C&D success in late 2024 but he's able when fresh and he's well handicapped
runners.name: Theyseekhimthere
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 8yo returning from an absence; able when fresh, as he was returning from 273 days off (and a wind operation) when staying on best for a 2l success over C&D in late 2024 (chase debut); only 2lb higher.

runners.comment: 9yo who's raced only nine times; clear of the rest when narrowly held at Lingfield latest
runners.name: Thruthelookinglass
runners.spotlight: A 9yo who has raced only nine times; just about the best of those was the latest when touched off at Lingfield (2m7f, soft) on only his third run over fences; the third was a long way back, so a 4lb rise could have been worse; player.

runners.comment: Two small-field wins in the autumn included one over C&D but his form has dipped
runners.name: Fern Hill
runners.owner: J E Harrison & Mrs S Case
runners.spotlight: Two small-field wins in the autumn included one over C&D but his form has dipped, including when second at Fakenham (beaten 26l); reservations about him at the minute.

runners.comment: Beaten about 8l into third at Ayr before his early departure at Ffos Las; 0-4 as a chaser
runners.name: Dangerous Touch
runners.spotlight: 2m4f handicap hurdle winner; has yet genuinely to threaten in his four chase starts, the best of them when 8l third at Ayr (3m, soft); fell at the first at Ffos Las last time; fairly treated should he pull his socks up.

13:23.race_name: Fairlight Studio Welcomes The Spring Novices' Hurdle (Go North Night Nurse Hurdle Qual') (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Irish maiden hurdle winner; has a big part to play if seeing out this new trip
runners.name: Dunkerque
runners.spotlight: Won maiden hurdle for Gavin Cromwell at Ballinrobe (2m1f, good) last July and has run okay in three handicaps since, most recently fifth of 11 on stable debut at Carlisle (2m1f, good to soft); showed promise on soft ground on the Flat in Denmark; has a big part to play if seeing out this new trip.

runners.comment: 5l win over C&D on recent rules debut and looks to have a bright future; major player
runners.name: Follow Your Luck
runners.spotlight: Won Irish maiden point (3m, yielding) last March on second start and, following £90,000 sale, scored by 5l over C&D (good to soft) on recent rules debut; looks to have a bright future and he's a major player today.

runners.comment: Fourth in Grade 2 at Cheltenham and he's the one to beat if he runs; also declared Thurles
runners.name: Open Secret
runners.spotlight: Flat winner who won a maiden hurdle at Naas (2m3f, soft to heavy) in December before creditable fourth in Grade 2 at Cheltenham (2m4f, soft) last month; he's the one to beat if he runs; also declared 3:17 Thurles today.

runners.comment: 22l behind stablemate Follow Your Luck over C&D but that gives him something to build on
runners.name: Fearless Dragon
runners.owner: N Jolley J Barnard & C Kennedy
runners.spotlight: Tailed off in sole bumper and 22l behind Follow Your Luck when fifth of ten at 200-1 on recent hurdle debut over C&D (good to soft); lots of improvement is needed to turn the tables with his stablemate but at least that latest run gives him something to build on; not ruled out each-way.

runners.comment: Not devoid of ability but beaten 32l at 125-1 on hurdle debut; may be best watched for now
runners.name: Mr Ramoon
runners.spotlight: Not devoid of ability in points and likewise on last month's hurdle debut at Newcastle (2m4f, good to soft) but he was well beaten at 125-1 on that occasion and may be best watched for now.

runners.comment: Second on debut in bumper at Hexham last March but unable to reproduce that promise since
runners.name: Tea Boy
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on debut in bumper at Hexham last March but unable to reproduce that promise since and tailed off/pulled up on his two hurdle starts.

13:58.race_name: Canine Premier Flex Plus Joint Supplement Handicap Chase (Go North One Man Series Qualifier) (GBB)

runners.comment: Progressive over h'dles in 2025; should be capable of better than he showed on chase debut
runners.name: Glen Road
runners.spotlight: Highly progressive over hurdles last year, winning four times (2m4f-2m7f, good to soft/soft); weakened quickly when soundly beaten sixth on last month's chase debut at Newcastle (2m4f, good to soft) but that's unlikely to be the limit of his ability over fences; no surprise to see a bold show.

runners.comment: Won readily over C&D on his second chase start and a 7lb rise may not stop him today
runners.name: Double Digits
runners.spotlight: Two novice hurdle wins last April (2m1f/2m, good) and he capitalised on the drop back in trip to win over C&D (good to soft) a fortnight ago on his second chase start; did it comfortably and a 7lb rise may not stop him today, provided the ground suits; runner-up in a point on yielding to soft.

runners.comment: Making headway when unseated three out at Ayr; contender if putting in a clear round
runners.name: Coup De Coeur
runners.spotlight: Jumping errors have been costly on his last two starts but he was making headway when unseating three out at Ayr (2m, soft) three weeks ago, and could have a part to play if putting in a clear round this afternoon.

runners.breeder: J C Haimet & A F Peter
runners.comment: The return to fences could help but he's been well below his best over hurdles this winter
runners.name: One Mill Harbour
runners.spotlight: Goes back over fences for the first time since winning at Hexham (1m7f, heavy) in November 2023, one of three chase victories that year; however, he's been well below his best over hurdles on his two runs this winter, following a long absence, and has lots to prove regarding current form.

runners.breeder: R F Broad & R S Bebb
runners.comment: Fairly encouraging run at Aintree last time and has had wind op since; possible player
runners.name: Roysse
runners.spotlight: Bumper (soft) and maiden hurdle (2m, good to soft) winner who took a step forward when third of three, beaten about 8l, at Aintree (2m, good to soft) on Boxing Day on his third chase start; he's since had a second wind operation and this southern raider may be able to build on that latest effort.

14:33.race_name: Sign Lead Your Horse To Water Handicap Hurdle (Go North Brindisi Breeze Series Qualifier)

runners.breeder: E A R L Trinquet & M & O Trinquet
runners.comment: Ex-Irish; four wins for James Owen, including two over fences here; this going not ideal
runners.name: Ivane
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish; has won four races since joining this yard, two of them over fences here (2m5f, 3m5f, good); has won on soft/heavy ground but best form on good/good to soft and below par on ground considered 'tacky' last time.

runners.comment: Best hurdles run when third over 3m1f in headgear last time; chance, but unproven on soft
runners.name: Dwight K Schrute
runners.spotlight: British point winner in 2023 (2m5f, good); won Fontwell maiden hurdle last March (2m3f, good); fair form in handicaps this term, last time finishing third at Warwick (3m1f, good to soft; first-time cheekpieces, second has won since); cheekpieces retained and a contender, although unproven on soft ground.

runners.comment: Two sound runs this term; not as good latest, but this significant drop in grade; chance
runners.name: Spike Jones
runners.spotlight: Two sound runs in the autumn but fell at Cheltenham in January and hasn't run quite as well since; this a significant drop in grade and with the ground in his favour, is one with a chance.

runners.comment: Won chase at Musselburgh in December; should stay 3m3f, well treated and could go well
runners.name: Forged Well
runners.owner: Mrs Suzy Brown & Peter R Brown
runners.spotlight: Won a handicap chase at Musselburgh in December (2m7f, good to soft); shapes as though this trip will suit, is 7lb lower over hurdles and could go well.

runners.comment: Goes hurdling for first time since March 2023 after three heavy defeats over fences
runners.name: Shighness
runners.spotlight: Goes hurdling for the first time since March 2023 having been well-beaten in her last three races over fences; bit to prove at present.

runners.comment: Consistent; last win in October 2022; creditable runs last three starts; each-way chance
runners.name: Guernesey
runners.spotlight: Consistent sort; hasn't won since October 2022, but has run creditably on last three starts and has an each-way chance.

runners.comment: C&D winner last time and chance off 3lb higher, with headgear now tried but this stronger
runners.name: Ballin Bay
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark for the season when winning over C&D earlier this month (good to soft); only 3lb higher, but this a stronger race; cheekpieces now tried; contender.

15:08.race_name: Seaside Travel Spectacular Shoreline Handicap Chase (Go North Red Rum Series Qualifier)

runners.comment: Has improved for cheekpieces with two wins this term, latest at Catterick; up 4lb; chance
runners.name: Defence Witness
runners.spotlight: Has improved for the addition of cheekpieces this season, winning at Cartmel in May (2m5f, good to soft) and last month at Catterick (3m1f, soft); first run here; chance off 4lb higher.

runners.comment: Huntingdon win with headgear in 2024; well beaten latest; headgear back on now; a possible
runners.name: Getaway Glory
runners.spotlight: Made a winning debut over fences at Huntingdon in April 2024 (2m7f, good; first-time cheekpieces); well behind Defence Witness after a 485-day break at Catterick last time (3m1f, soft; no cheekpieces); should come on for that and interesting with headgear back on.

runners.comment: Two Hexham wins last term' pulled up after a break last time; not sure 3m3f on soft ideal
runners.name: Ballydangan
runners.spotlight: Won twice over 3m at Hexham last year (good); pulled up when returning from a short break at Catterick last time; conditions perhaps not ideal and a bit to prove.

runners.comment: Second at Hexham in May; disappointing since; on a very good mark so wouldn't rule out
runners.name: Community Rebel
runners.spotlight: Runner-up at Hexham in May (3m, good to soft) on final start for James Ewart; mainly disappointing since joining Micky Hammond, but has dropped 20lb in the ratings so wouldn't rule out completely.

runners.comment: Newcastle winner in November 2023; disappointing since and is hard to fancy
runners.name: Goodoldbill
runners.spotlight: Won a novice handicap chase at Newcastle in November 2023 (2m7f, soft); mainly disappointing since and hard to fancy.

15:43.race_name: Happy Birthday Becca Handicap Hurdle (Go North Cab On Target Series Qualifier)

runners.comment: Gained his second course win over this trip last time; up 5lb; should go well again
runners.name: Thank You Blue
runners.spotlight: Won here for second time when taking handicap over this trip last time (good to soft); seems to go on soft and could go well off this 5lb higher mark.

runners.comment: Course winner; good 4th at Haydock last time; now 2lb lower with headgear tried; big shout
runners.name: North Parade
runners.spotlight: Course winner; last three wins were over 2m4f at Newcastle in 2023/4; sound run when fourth at Haydock last time (2m3f, good to soft); now 2lb lower and interesting with cheekpieces tried.

runners.comment: Ex-Irish; fair second over 2m last time; should improve on that back over 2m4f
runners.name: A Mere Bagatelle

runners.name: Alidam

runners.comment: Two wins (second over C&D) for Fergal O'Brien last term; not done as well for new yard

runners.comment: 1m5f Musselburgh Flat winner in August; fair form over hurdles since, but a bit to find

runners.spotlight: Won a low-grade handicap on the Flat at Musselburgh in August (1m5f, good); fair form in three runs since returning to hurdles, including on handicap debut last time; bit to find.

runners.comment: Ex-Irish; ordinary form so far including on h'cap debut; needs to improve on stable debut
runners.name: My Boy Christy
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish; unexposed, but ordinary form so far, including on handicap debut; needs to improve on first run for new yard.

runners.name: Halpha Soleil

runners.comment: Won over 2m4f at Ayr in November; two fair runs since; could go well off current good mark
runners.name: Too Cool Forshrule
runners.spotlight: Ex-Greenall/Guerriero; 2m4f winner at Ayr in November (soft) and two fair runs since; back on a decent mark; could go well.

runners.comment: Decisive winner over 2m3f here last time and should fare even better at this trip
runners.name: Mersey Street
runners.spotlight: Decisive winner over 2m3f here last time (good to soft); this longer trip will suit (has won over 3m1f) and should go well despite 6lb rise.

runners.name: Uncle Al

runners.name: Cave Hill

runners.name: Rock N Roll Champ
runners.spotlight: Maiden; didn't show a great deal in two runs over fences last summer; fair form over hurdles since; bit to prove.

15:57.race_name: Join The Midnite Movement Handicap (Rider Restricted Race) (GBBPlus Race)

runners.comment: Fourth penultimate start; unsuited by dropping back in trip (1m4f; off slow pace) latest.
runners.name: Chemistry
runners.owner: James Paul Services To Industry Ltd
runners.spotlight: Listed winner (awarded race) for Aidan O'Brien in 2024; low key on first two starts for this trainer before an encouraging fourth (Alrazeen second and Sax Appeal third) at Southwell (2m) on penultimate start; reportedly unsuited by dropping back in trip (off slow pace) latest; this looks a better fit.

runners.breeder: Saleh Al Homaizi & Imad Al Sagar
runners.comment: Runner-up at Dundalk (2m; 8-1) in November; best watched on first start for new stable.

runners.breeder: C&s B/S Ltd C Younghusband K McGivern
runners.comment: No excuses when fifth to progressive rival at Wolverhampton (2m) latest; needs career best
runners.name: Sax Appeal
runners.spotlight: Third, one place behind Alrazeen (Chemistry fourth), at Southwell in December prior to justifying favouritism there (2m; off 5lb lower) later that month; no excuses when fifth (beaten under 4l) to the progressive Ribble Vibe at Wolverhampton latest; consistent but needs career best from this mark.

runners.comment: Returned with a sound effort at Southwell (2m) in December; player from a 1lb higher mark.
runners.name: Alrazeen
runners.spotlight: 5-14 on AW; stopped quickly in last year's Northumberland Plate and it was a similar story in added cheekpieces at Wolverhampton (1m6f) the following month; afforded time off thereafter, returning with a sound effort at Southwell (2m; beaten a neck) in December; key player from a 1lb higher mark.

runners.comment: 1lb below last winning mark but breaking slowly continues to hold him back.
runners.name: Humble Spark
runners.spotlight: Midfield (beaten 14l) in last year's All-Weather Championships Marathon over C&D; has slipped to 1lb below his last winning mark (and claimer ridden) but breaking slowly continues to hold him back, as was the case when fifth (one place behind Weddell Sea) over C&D 34 days ago.

runners.comment: Tailed off on stable debut at Wolverhampton (1m4f; 20-1) fortnight ago; risky proposition.
runners.name: Vaguely Royal
runners.spotlight: Two AW wins (up to 12.5f) and his most recent success came over hurdles at Wincanton (1m7f maiden; for Anthony Charlton) in October 2024; mostly poor (0-4) for Syd Hosie in 2025 and tailed off after a slow start on stable debut at Wolverhampton (1m4f; 20-1) a fortnight ago; risky proposition.

runners.comment: Better when third at Wolverhampton (2m, Class 5; 66-1) latest; tough task in this Class 3.
runners.name: Fleurman
runners.spotlight: No win since scoring over C&D (for Olly Murphy; from 12lb higher) in February 2023; took a step back in a more favourable direction when third to an odds-on favourite at Wolverhampton (2m; 66-1) latest; still early days with this trainer but this race is two grades higher (Class 3) than latest.

runners.comment: Three Class 5 C&D wins; respectable effort in a Class 2 C&D contest (fourth, 16-1) latest.

runners.spotlight: Three Class 5 C&D wins, the latest by a nose on penultimate start; ran respectably in a Class 2 C&D contest (fourth, 16-1) latest; likely to give his best, although others make more appeal.

runners.comment: 2-6 for G Tutty; changed hands for 47,000gns; tongue-tie added; new trip for stable debut
runners.name: Team Player
runners.spotlight: Won twice for Gemma Tutty, including when pouncing late at Lingfield (1m4f, Class 4; 11-4) in September; finished last of three in a tactical affair over 12.5f here (4-7 favourite) in October and has since changed hands for 47,000gns; tongue-tie added; new trip for stable debut.

runners.comment: Boxed on into third at Lingfield (2m) latest; this stiffer track could suit; considered.
runners.name: Educator
runners.spotlight: Won twice last year, including on AW at Lingfield (1m4f; 28-1; same mark); in decent shape in 2026, runner-up at Kempton (2m) on penultimate start, before boxing on into third at Lingfield (2m, Class 4) latest; this stiffer track could suit; needs considering.

runners.comment: Edged out Sax Appeal at Southwell (2m) in September latest; new mark is far from punitive
runners.name: Hatysa
runners.spotlight: Progressive; made the breakthrough at Southwell (1m6f) in July; saw off Weddell Sea to win over C&D (by just over 4l) in September, before edging out Sax Appeal at Southwell (2m, Class 4) a fortnight later; this mark (2lb higher) is far from punitive if she is ready to roll off a 151-day break.

16:30.race_name: Read Meg Nicholls' Blog At betmgm.co.uk Handicap (Rider Restricted Race)

runners.comment: Bit better at Wolverhampton (6f) latest; gelded and fitted with a hood for handicap debut
runners.name: Ocean Of Storms
runners.spotlight: 280,000euros yearling; failed to shine in three novice/maiden events, albeit faring a bit better over a shorter trip at Wolverhampton (6f; fourth, 20-1) in October last time; gelded and fitted with a hood (usually races freely) for handicap debut; perhaps has simply needed time.

runners.comment: Placed in two of his four qualifying runs, all 7f; gelded for handicap debut

runners.comment: 0-5; too free in newly applied blinkers (discarded now) at Wolverhampton three weeks ago.

runners.comment: Eight of 11 in 6f fillies' novice at Southwell (150-1) latest; low mark for handicap debut

runners.spotlight: 50,000euros yearling; has struggled to make her presence felt, only eight of 11 in a 6f fillies' novice at Southwell (150-1) on her most recent appearance; has low mark from which to begin life in handicap company.

runners.comment: Near miss to stablemate over C&D (10-1) four weeks ago; likely playing for a place again.

runners.spotlight: Yet to win (0-9) but did hit the line strongly when missing out by a nose to stablemate Surgeon Commander over C&D (10-1) four weeks ago; it appears that the recent application of cheekpieces has suited; seemingly playing for a place again.

runners.name: Swiss Ace
runners.spotlight: Losing run stretches back to December 2023; ran okay over C&D in November off a 7lb higher mark but he hasn't built on it since.

runners.comment: Two wins last month but 0-55 and 0-50 classified; perhaps vulnerable in this stronger race
runners.name: Call Glory
runners.spotlight: Two wins at Southwell last month (6f and 7f), the latest in a classified event; couldn't cope with a Class 5 over C&D two weeks ago and this looks quite a useful race for the grade.

runners.comment: Capable of popping up at big prices; sharper for stable debut last month; not ruled out
runners.name: Koji
runners.spotlight: The winner of three of her 23 starts, with the wins coming at 33-1, 20-1 and 66-1; on a feasible mark and should be sharper for last month's return to action/stable debut; not ruled out.

runners.comment: Strong finish when winning a similar C&D event nine days ago; major player under a penalty

runners.name: Bella Love

runners.comment: 0-35 for current stable and not firing this winter; too much to prove

runners.comment: Exposed 19-race maiden; returning to 6f not enough to tempt here

runners.comment: Classified win at Wolverhampton last month has been followed by three good handicap runs

runners.comment: No better for the return to AW here two weeks ago; too much to prove at present

runners.comment: Unplaced all nine starts but has shown some ability; now tackles his first classified race
runners.name: Pebble Dash
runners.spotlight: Unplaced in all nine starts but he has shown some promise, including over C&D; now drops into his first classified race.

runners.comment: The odd good run this winter but over 5l behind The Gay Blade here nine days ago
runners.name: Yaahobby
runners.spotlight: He has run some fair races this winter (had a third wind op prior to his return in October) but he was never in contention behind The Gay Blade over C&D nine days ago; others appeal more for win purposes.

runners.breeder: Highclere Stud & Mr Ilyas Emir Karadag
runners.comment: Down the field in this grade on his last three starts; not easily recommended

runners.spotlight: Down the field in this grade on his last three starts; not easily recommended.

runners.comment: Not fired for new yard this winter but dropping into a 0-50 could help turn things around
runners.name: Classy Clarets

runners.comment: Not at best latest but earlier C&D runs bring him right into the reckoning at this level
runners.name: Fircombe Hall
runners.spotlight: Not at his best two weeks ago but he had been knocking at the door in minor handicaps beforehand; one to take seriously at this level.

runners.comment: 13-race maiden; only seventh at this level last time and remains opposable
runners.name: Genius Mistake
runners.spotlight: 0-13 and she has finished no better than midfield in four runs for her new stable, including at this level last month.

runners.comment: Only beaten 3l on Sunday which represented his best run this winter; more needed to win
runners.name: Nazca
runners.spotlight: Ran his best race this winter when beaten 3l in a 5f handicap here on Sunday (blinkered first time); still only seventh of the nine runners there though and he needs another step forward to take this.

runners.name: Shesashambles
runners.spotlight: Just one win from 34 starts; third in a similar event over C&D nine days ago but beaten 3.75l; more required to win.

runners.comment: Conditions to suit and drops into 0-50 company with his yard amongst the winners; chance
runners.name: Tickets
runners.spotlight: Conditions to suit and although this winter's efforts haven't been his best, this does represent an ease in grade; stable going well and he is more appealing than most.

runners.comment: Latest C&D fourth was a bit more like it (well backed); tongue tie back on; unexposed
runners.name: Wingstar
runners.spotlight: It was a weak race in which she finished fourth on her handicap debut here two weeks ago but she was heavily backed and the run offered hope of better; tongue tie returns today; unexposed and that doesn't apply to many of her rivals.

20:00.race_name: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap (Rider Restricted Race)

runners.comment: Runner-up over C&D when last seen 12 weeks ago; dangerous if ready to roll after a break
runners.name: Binadham
runners.spotlight: Not added to his debut win but he is more realistically handicapped now and he has run well in defeat on his last three starts; the latest was over C&D 12 weeks ago and he should give it another good go if ready to roll after the break.

runners.comment: Placed in five of his six runs for this yard; no obvious reason he wouldn't go well again
runners.name: True Promise
runners.spotlight: Placed in five of his six starts for Fionn McSharry, the latest outing a good second over 5f at Southwell 12 days ago; no obvious reason he won't give another good account.

runners.comment: Unplaced in two runs for this yard but down in class and on dangerous mark; tongue tie off
runners.name: Pop Star
runners.spotlight: Unplaced in two runs for new stable but they came in Class 4 company and he could prove a more potent force down at this level; usual tongue tie absent this time.

runners.comment: Narrow defeat here last month (6f); still feasibly weighted if getting good pace to aim at
runners.name: Dandy Magic
runners.spotlight: 6f win here in November off 4lb lower; better form when missing out by a nose here (6f) five weeks ago; will need a good pace back at 5f but should remain competitive.

runners.comment: C&D win in December; not so good last month when behind Dandy Magic
runners.name: Hover On The Wind
runners.spotlight: Gained his first AW success when landing a Class 5 C&D handicap in December; only midfield here on New Year's Day (behind Dandy Magic) and he needs to raise his game.

runners.comment: Three-time C&D winner; 2lb rise for latest success not punitive; each-way claims at least
runners.name: Dark Kestrel
runners.spotlight: His last three wins have come over C&D, latterly 13 days ago when leading late on (for today's apprentice Ethan Tindall); has the ability to defy a 2lb rise and this should be run to suit.

runners.comment: Conditions to suit and arrives in good form; should make another bold bid
runners.name: Our Absent Friends
runners.spotlight: Made all in a Class 6 over C&D in December; good placed efforts in two of his three runs this year (second to Digital last month and 6lb better off today) and another prominent showing seems likely.

runners.comment: 3-6 since headgear returned in December; penalised/up in class but still a solid contender
runners.name: Digital
runners.owner: Fine Claret Racing And Mrs R Carr
runners.spotlight: The return of cheekpieces has revived his fortunes this winter and he arrives having won three of his last six starts (all C&D), the latest a front-running win on Sunday; a 4lb penalty in a stronger race asks more of him but he still has handicapping scope.

runners.breeder: Boyce Bloodstock & Mrs C E Percival
runners.comment: Beaten by reopposing rivals in his last three starts; stable also runs Our Absent Friends
runners.name: Harb
runners.spotlight: Creditable efforts in defeat in races won by reopposing rivals on his last three starts; stable may have stronger claims with Our Absent Friends.
